intro: Thick Bear Fur is a prized pelt gathered from the cold-hardened bears roaming the snowdrifts of Dun Morogh. Coveted for its heat retention, it is commonly used by traveling scouts and soldiers to craft insulation and warm bedding against the bitter alpine freeze.

p: The bears prowling the ridges of Dun Morogh endure some of the harshest snowfields in the Eastern Kingdoms. Their thick, resilient coats provide vital protection from blizzards, making the pelt an invaluable resource for locals and travelers alike. Rather than being discarded as scrap, these heavy pelts are regularly harvested by hunters and used to line clothes, insulate drafty outposts, and pad cold sleeping rolls.

When Pilot Bellowfiz began outfitting his siege tank, Jetsteam, at Steelgrill's Depot, he faced the harsh prospect of spending a full month in the field on a long mission for the Siege Brigade. Because cold iron offers little comfort in high-altitude snowbanks, he commissioned local scouts to gather thick bear furs from the snow fields south of the Grizzled Den to fashion warm bedding for his cabin quarters.
